results.title: North Korean hacker who tried to defect to South Korea was imprisoned in the basement of the North Korean embassy in China.
results.description:
North Korean hacker who tried to defect to South Korea was imprisoned in the basement of the North Korean embassy in China.

He was forcibly repatriated to North Korea disguised as a patient, with his entire body cast in plaster.

He passed away in North Korea after being forcibly returned.

There are no words.

Source: Weekly Chosun
